name: safety
description: Protected Files (deny writes to .env, lockfiles, vault files) and Auto-checkpoint (side-ref snapshots of the working tree). Spends no tokens.

mod_protect_enabled.title: Protected Files
mod_protect_enabled.description: Enable the protect mod (gates writes to protected paths).

mod_checkpoint_enabled.title: Auto-checkpoint
mod_checkpoint_enabled.description: Enable the checkpoint mod (side-ref snapshots of the working tree).

protect_mode.title: Protect mode
protect_mode.description: deny blocks the write, warn only shows a toast, off disables.

protect_group_lockfiles.title: Protect lockfiles
protect_group_lockfiles.description: Protect package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, bun.lock, bun.lockb, Cargo.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock.

protect_group_vault.title: Protect vault files
protect_group_vault.description: Protect the Obsidian vault's Boards/Engineering.md, .obsidian/** and Ledger/**.

protect_globs.title: Extra protected globs
protect_globs.description: Comma list of globs (*, **, ?), absolute, ~ or repo-relative.

protect_allow.title: Env exceptions
protect_allow.description: Comma list of basename globs never treated as secrets.

protect_bash.title: Check Bash
protect_bash.description: Best-effort check of shell writes, deletes and moves.

protect_mcpRules.title: MCP write rules
protect_mcpRules.description: JSON list [{"tool":"mcp__x__y","arg":"path"}] of MCP tools to inspect. Empty by default.

checkpoint_enabled.title: Checkpoints on
checkpoint_enabled.description: Take checkpoints after turns that changed files.

checkpoint_keepDays.title: Keep days
checkpoint_keepDays.description: Checkpoint refs older than this are deleted at session start.

checkpoint_maxUntracked.title: Max untracked files
checkpoint_maxUntracked.description: Skip checkpoints when more untracked files than this exist.

checkpoint_maxPerSession.title: Max per session
checkpoint_maxPerSession.description: Stop checkpointing after this many in one session.

checkpoint_exclude.title: Excluded globs
checkpoint_exclude.description: Comma list of globs kept out of checkpoints.

checkpoint_statusLine.title: Status line
checkpoint_statusLine.description: Show the one-line safety status under the prompt.
